description.html: The Atman CH-50W is the smaller model of the Noble Heater series: a 50 W submersible heater with a built-in thermostat and a transparent housing. You choose the temperature with the dial on top, and the thermostat switches heating on and off when the water reaches the set value. It is intended for smaller tropical aquariums, betta tanks and quarantine tanks.

Choose heater wattage by aquarium volume and room temperature: a larger tank and a colder room need a stronger heater. If the room is cold or the tank has no lid, choose a stronger model or two smaller heaters at opposite ends of the aquarium. If you are not sure which wattage you need, ask us.

Place the heater at an angle or upright where water flows well, for example next to the filter outlet, so heat spreads evenly. It must be submerged up to the marked line. Before taking it out of the water, unplug it and let it cool down, as a hot heater can crack out of water. Always check the temperature with a thermometer.
Call us or message us on WhatsApp to order. Courier delivery across Serbia, free pickup in Novi Sad.
